title: Working on a 5v5 FPS, with a singleplayer micro-extraction mode
author: iron_o_games
selftext:
I started a game studio to see how far I can push AI game development. Not just one-shots or demos either, complete games from my extensive idea backlog!

**KILLFACTION** is my first project!

The game is a micro-extraction shooter that works a bit like a rogue-lite:

1. Carry out short missions on procedural maps
2. Earn money if you succeed
3. Buy equipment and cosmetics
4. Extract with your stuff in between missions
5. If you fail or die, you loose it all

Simultaneously, you can play 5v5 PVP mode online!

It's not just a demo, it's basically done (first round of cosmetics and all) - I'm at the network optimization phase, and just beginning marketing.

**HOW IT WAS MADE:**

* Took about 2-3 months to get it to this point.
* It was done with heavy ChatGPT usage - mostly Astra.
* Godot (no MCP, the AI can just edit godot files!)
* Local AI for the player model generation (Trellis 2 I believe).
* Some of my own techniques for achieving consistency and clean rigging too.
* Mixamo for animations.
* Paid assets for the guns and hand animations.
* [freesound.org](http://freesound.org) and pixabay for sounds and music.
* Also have a sound designer friend who is going to help me improve the gun audio.

Let me know if you want more development details. Would also love advice on 3D model generation :)
